hub.title: Routes
hub.subtitle: Import or draw a route, then send it to your watch

library.emptyDescription: Keep routes here and send them to your watch to see the route line and your position on outdoor runs, rides and walks. There are five ways to add one:

ways.w1: Pick a GPX or TCX file from your phone with Import GPX/TCX.
ways.w2: Open a GPX or TCX file from Strava, Garmin, Komoot or another app, then choose Share or Open with JoyoFit.
ways.w3: Draw your own route on the map with Draw on map.
ways.w4: Reuse the route of a workout your watch recorded with From a workout.
ways.w5: Make a new loop from your door with New loop from home: pick steps, distance, time or kcal, and JoyoFit finds streets you have not walked.

guide.title: How to start on the watch
guide.sentLead: The route is on your watch. Here's how to use it:
guide.intro: A route doesn't start by itself. You pick it on the watch before you begin a workout:

steps.s2: Pick a supported outdoor mode: outdoor run, cycling or outdoor walk.
steps.s3: On the screen before the start, tap the settings icon (gear) on the right. On a HarmonyOS 6 watch, swipe that screen up and tap More.
steps.s4: Choose Route, then pick the route you just sent.
steps.s5: Turn on workout navigation, then start the workout.

guide.during: During the workout, the route line and your position show on the watch screen.
guide.deleteOnWatch: Want to remove a route from the watch? In the Routes menu, long-press it.

limits.l1: Routes only work for outdoor running, cycling and walking.
limits.l2: The watch shows the route line and your position. There are no turn-by-turn directions.
limits.l3: The watch simplifies long routes to a few hundred points, so small bends may not show.
limits.l4: Only watches that list route support can receive routes.
